description: Wire transfer instructions issued by an escrow or title company for closing funds

issuer.description: The company issuing the instructions and receiving the funds

name.description: The issuing company's name, from the letterhead or the opening paragraph

address.description: The issuing company's address from the letterhead, as one line

phone.description: The main phone number from the letterhead

receiving_bank.description: The bank the funds are wired to

address.description: The bank's street address, city, state and ZIP as one line

attention.description: The department named after 'Attn', if any

aba_routing_number.description: The ABA routing number, digits only

account_name.description: The beneficiary account name, as printed

account_type.description: The kind of account named in the account name, e.g. 'IOLTA', 'escrow' or 'trust'; null if none is named

reference_number.description: The order, file or escrow number to quote as the wire reference

property_address.description: The property address the funds relate to, as one line

attention.description: The team or unit named on the 'Attention' line

wire_only.description: True if the instructions say closing funds must be sent by wire transfer

ach_accepted.description: False if the instructions say ACH transfers are not accepted; true if they say ACH is accepted; null if not stated
